ideas.title: Vite Builds Succeed but the Server Serves the Wrong `dist` Folder
ideas.description: Why a deployment can show an old or empty app after a successful Vite build, and how to point the server at the right output.
ideas.angle: Cover the case where the build command writes one output directory but the host, adapter, or static server serves another path. Explain how Vite emits assets, why stale build directories and mismatched root settings cause the wrong files to be served, then show how to align `root`, `build.outDir`, and the deployment target.

ideas.title: Next.js Route Handlers Throw TypeError: Body has already been read After Parsing `request.json()` Twice
ideas.description: Why a Next.js route handler fails after the request body is consumed more than once, and how to preserve the stream.
ideas.angle: Explain the fetch body model: a request stream can be consumed only once, so a second `request.json()`, `text()`, or `formData()` call throws. Cover why this happens in route handlers and middleware, then show the fix by reading once, cloning before consumption when needed, or passing the parsed object through.

ideas.title: Next.js Loads a Self-Hosted Font with FOIT After `next/font` Is Skipped
ideas.description: How a self-hosted font flashes or swaps late in Next.js when it bypasses `next/font` optimization.
ideas.angle: Explain why manually loading a local font file can produce invisible text or late swapping, and how `next/font/local` changes preload behavior, CSS generation, and fallback metrics. Cover the rendering path, the mechanism behind FOIT/FOUT, and the exact code shape that avoids it.

ideas.title: Nuxt Breaks in the Browser When a Client Component Imports a Server-Only Composable
ideas.description: Why a browser component crashes after importing a composable that touches server-only APIs in Nuxt.
ideas.angle: Explain how Nuxt composables can rely on request-scoped or server-only context and why importing them into client code produces runtime failures or missing data. Cover module boundaries, the difference between universal and server-only composables, and the supported patterns for moving the shared logic behind `useAsyncData()`, plugins, or server routes.

ideas.title: React Native Android Fails with "Duplicate class" During Gradle Compilation
ideas.description: Why Android builds stop on duplicate classes in React Native and how to identify the conflicting dependency.
ideas.angle: Explain how two transitive dependencies can contribute the same Java/Kotlin class to the Android classpath and trigger the Gradle duplicate-class error. Cover how to inspect the dependency graph, find the conflicting artifact, and resolve it with version alignment, exclusions, or a package upgrade.

ideas.title: Docker Compose Cannot Resolve a Service Name Because the Container Is on the Wrong Network
ideas.description: Why one Compose service cannot reach another by name and how network membership controls DNS resolution.
ideas.angle: Explain the built-in DNS behavior in Docker Compose and why service-name lookup fails when containers are attached to different networks or when the target service is only on an external network. Cover the name-resolution rules, the effect of custom networks and aliases, and the configuration that makes service-to-service traffic work reliably.

ideas.title: Bun Starts a Package Binary but the Command Is Not Found in `node_modules/.bin`
ideas.description: Why a Bun-installed CLI fails to launch from a package binary and how to expose the executable correctly.
ideas.angle: Explain how Bun installs package executables, how the `bin` field maps to a launcher, and why a wrong or missing path leaves no usable command in `node_modules/.bin`. Cover the packaging rules, the generated wrapper, and the exact `package.json` structure that makes the binary discoverable.

drafted.title: Bun Publishes a CLI That Runs Without `node_modules/.bin` When the Binary Field Is Wrong
drafted.description: How a Bun package can ship successfully but expose no working command because the bin entry points at the wrong file.
drafted.angle: Explain how package managers resolve the `bin` field and why a bad path or missing shebang leaves the installed command unusable. Cover Bun-specific publishing details, the executable bit, and the difference between local test runs and installed package behavior, then show how to point `bin` at the real entry file and verify it after packing.
